nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

**Key inputs**

- **prompt**: describe the shots, camera moves, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

subject_definitions
<Subject 1> is a stylish blonde female influencer in her mid-20s wearing trendy sunglasses, a white turtleneck shirt, and a casual leather jacket.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1).

summary
[reference generation + audio reference] The target video is a 15-second high-fidelity selfie-style clip featuring <Subject 1> walking down a bustling city street while delivering an energetic monologue directly to the camera, accompanied by ambient urban sounds and clear voice dialogue.

retention_analysis
<Subject 1> ([Shot 1] / main character): fully_preserved - Maintains exact appearance, clothing details, and natural handheld walking motion throughout the clip.
<Audio 1> ([Shot 1] / dialogue track): reference - Provides the energetic vocal timbre and lip-sync target for the monologue delivery.

detailed_description
[Shot 1] The camera is held in a selfie position by <Subject 1>, capturing her face and upper body as she walks forward with natural handheld motion under bright, clear daylight. Modern storefronts and soft-focus pedestrians pass behind her. She maintains direct eye contact with the lens, displaying realistic micro-expressions and perfect lip-sync for speaker (S1). Her energetic voice begins: <d>[English] I went out for a quick coffee.</d> She continues walking at a steady pace, the urban environment blurring slightly due to motion. <d>[English] Just coffee.</d> A slight smile forms as she gestures subtly with her free hand while footsteps on the sidewalk and distant traffic fill the background. <d>[English] Somehow I bought a pastry, a candle, and a plant I absolutely do not have the emotional stability to keep alive.</d> She chuckles softly, her sunglasses catching brief glints of sunlight. The camera remains steady despite the walking motion, keeping her centered in the frame. <d>[English] So yeah, I'd say the morning is going really well.</d> She finishes with a relaxed nod as ambient chatter and city sounds fade naturally into the background atmosphere.

overall_soundscape
High-fidelity ambient city sounds dominate the environment, including distant traffic hum, crisp footsteps on concrete pavement, and muffled chatter from nearby pedestrians and storefronts. The audio mix emphasizes spatial depth with a soft-focus background atmosphere that complements the walking motion without overpowering the foreground voice.

non_diegetic_music
No non-diegetic music is present.

## Frame Count and Shot Duration

MiniMax generates at 24 FPS. Its valid frame counts follow `17k + 5`, where `k` is any whole number. You do not need to calculate it; use one of these values:

| Frames | Approx. duration |
|---:|---:|
| 73 | 3.04 seconds |
| 124 | 5.17 seconds |
| 243 | 10.13 seconds |
| 362 | 15.08 seconds (approx. trained maximum) |

For Multishot, this duration applies to each shot. Example: two 243-frame shots produce about 20.2 seconds after the duplicated seam frame is removed.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
